label: Athletic & Sportswear
description: What people actually train, ride and compete in. Sportswear was the one everyday wardrobe register the library had no entry for at all.

items.name: gym-training-set
items.text: a matched gym training set in technical knit, a cropped support top and high-waisted leggings, flat seams and a phone pocket at the thigh

items.name: running-kit
items.text: lightweight running kit, a perforated singlet over split-hem shorts, reflective piping at the seams and a watch turned to the inside of the wrist
items.text_short: lightweight running singlet and split shorts

items.name: yoga-layers
items.text: soft yoga layers, a ribbed bodysuit under an oversized cotton wrap, bare feet and hair tied back without ceremony
items.text_short: ribbed yoga bodysuit under a cotton wrap

items.name: boxing-gear
items.text: boxing gear, satin shorts with a high waistband, laced gloves and wrapped hands, a towel across the shoulders and tape at the ankles
items.text_short: satin boxing shorts, laced gloves, wrapped hands

items.name: tennis-whites
items.text: tennis whites, a pleated skirt and collared polo, a sweatband at the wrist and court shoes with a herringbone sole
items.text_short: pleated tennis whites and a collared polo

items.name: football-strip
items.text: a football strip, a lightweight numbered shirt over shorts, socks pulled over shin guards and studs caked with turf
items.text_short: numbered football strip, studs caked with turf

items.name: cycling-lycra
items.text: a cycling kit in aero lycra, a full-zip jersey with rear pockets loaded, bib shorts with a gripper hem and mitts tanned at the wrist line
items.text_short: aero cycling jersey and bib shorts

items.name: ski-shell
items.text: a ski shell and salopettes, taped seams and a powder skirt, goggles pushed up onto a helmet and gloves clipped to the hip
items.text_short: taped ski shell and salopettes, goggles up

items.name: swim-training-suit
items.text: a one-piece training swimsuit in matte competition fabric, a high-cut leg and a crossed back, cap and goggles marked from a long session

items.name: racing-suit
items.text: a fireproof racing suit unzipped to the waist with the sleeves tied off, a nomex undershirt beneath and a balaclava pushed back off the head
items.text_short: racing suit unzipped, sleeves tied at the waist

items.name: motocross-kit
items.text: motocross kit, a vented jersey over a chest protector, reinforced pants and boots buckled to the shin, roost dried across one whole side
items.text_short: vented motocross jersey over a chest protector

items.name: athleisure-street
items.text: athleisure worn off the pitch, a zip-through track top over a crop, wide-leg joggers cuffed at the ankle and box-fresh trainers
items.text_short: track top, wide-leg joggers and fresh trainers

items.name: climbing-gear
items.text: climbing gear, a harness over cropped leggings, a chalk bag at the small of the back, taped fingers and shoes hooked to a belt loop
items.text_short: climbing harness, chalk bag and taped fingers

items.name: gi-martial-arts
items.text: a heavy cotton gi with a worn belt double-wrapped at the waist, lapels softened by years of washing and bare feet on a matted floor
items.text_short: heavy cotton gi with a worn double-wrapped belt
